title: Senior CRM Administrator

Evaluate, integrate, and get the best out of CRM-adjacent tooling - diallers, sequencing tools, conversation intelligence, and AI-powered solutions - working closely with the teams and vendors who build them. Support key AI initiatives in the telesales setup - for example, contributing to the transition to a new AI calling provider, the rollout of a sales rep copilot, and conversational-insight tools that draw on calls, email, and chat - by handling the CRM integration, data flow, configuration, and adoption. Excellent stakeholder management: you can navigate competing priorities and influence without authority. A clear, confident communicator - equally comfortable writing a technical spec and presenting to a non-technical audience. title: Senior Product Engineer (Full Stack)

For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier; for our partners, it is the most convenient and safe way to do business across borders. Behind it, our software and agentic AI do the heavy lifting that used to take an asset-intensive supply chain with four or five intermediaries and weeks of manual coordination. Agents are only as good as the product around them: reliable data, well-designed APIs, and interfaces where our team can review, correct and approve what an agent proposes before real money and real shipments move. As a Senior Product Engineer, you own business problems end to end. You talk to the people who use what you build, decide with Product what to solve, and ship the whole slice: data model, services, AI agents and the user interface. What you will do Own a business problem from first conversation to production and beyond, for example making supplier pricing reliable from ingestion all the way to the quote a salesperson sends. Build backend services for pricing, inventory, orders and the integrations that connect suppliers, customers and logistics partners. Build our AI agents and the tools and APIs they use, and make their actions safe through idempotency, validation, audit trails and human review where it matters. Design and build the interfaces where our commercial teams work with agents: reviewing proposals, correcting mistakes and approving decisions quickly. Turn messy external data such as supplier price lists, datasheets and stock feeds into trustworthy data the rest of the business relies on. Measure whether what you shipped works, including evaluating and monitoring LLM-driven workflows in production. Lead technical decisions, write down the trade-offs, and mentor other engineers through code review, pairing and direct feedback. Help us hire by running interviews and defining what good engineering looks like at Andercore. In your first six months, you might Build a pricing engine that scales with our growing assortment and number of markets, and serves correct prices to sales, and later directly to customers, in milliseconds. Automate procurement: turn supplier price lists, quotes and order confirmations into structured data, and let AI agents handle the manual steps between our buyers and suppliers. What you bring At least 5 years of experience building and running software in production, with real users and real consequences when it fails. Strong backend skills at production scale in Java or a comparable language such as Kotlin, C# or Go, and willingness to work in Java and Spring Boot. Experience designing distributed, event-driven systems, with a focus on data correctness and failure modes. Solid command of PostgreSQL and hands-on experience with AWS. Your depth is on the backend, but full-stack delivery is expected: you build frontends in TypeScript and React. You don't need to be a frontend specialist, but you can ship a good interface for the problem you own. Product sense: you ask why before how, you talk to users, and you can turn a vague problem into a clear plan. Experience in a fast-growing company, where priorities shift and you keep shipping while the business changes around you. A track record of solving business problems, not only technical ones. Experience building with LLMs or agent frameworks is a strong plus. Curiosity and good engineering judgment about them is a must.
